snippet.title: VALDRYS - A New Indie MMORPG | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Valdrys is a dark-fantasy MMORPG — real-time combat, deep dungeons, and open-world PvP — built by a solo developer.

⚔️ Play now: https://play.valdrys.com

Forge your legend across a living world:
• Real-time, skill-based combat
• Classes to fit your playstyle — Archer, Paladin, Mage, Healer, and more
• Party dungeons: solo, duo, and 5-player runs
• World bosses and roaming threats
• Team arenas and full-loot PvP zones
• Guilds, trading, and a player-driven economy
• Gathering, crafting, and gear progression via the Aether Forge

A hand-built indie MMO — new content lands often. Come help shape it.

🌐 Website: https://valdrys.com
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: comming soon!
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/zN4wyUpXUc

#MMORPG #IndieGame #Valdrys #MMO #IndieMMO #PCGaming #DungeonCrawler
